prompt:
Use case: strong style-transfer and integrated costume refinement.
Redraw the character in IMAGE 1 in the actual project GEM ICON PAINTING STYLE of IMAGES 2 and 3, shorten her skirt modestly to reveal a lighter leg silhouette, completely redesign the three talisman graphics, and integrate a SMALL amount of Daoist-inspired visual language.

INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 = character identity, pose, silhouette and costume concept ONLY. Preserve youthful gentle face, silver hair, swept-back slender butterfly antennas, big asymmetric triangular purple butterfly CLOAK with TWO long eye-tipped swallowtails, raised palm with three hovering paper talismans and coherent three-quarter LEFT direction.
Images 2/3 = PRIMARY drawing/style authority. Their strong dark contour, large decisive painted planes, quiet color areas and matte broad brush marks must visibly replace image 1's soft fine-lined anime finish. This is a hand-painted game icon aesthetic, not literal jewel material on skin/clothes.

SAFE YOUTHFUL DESIGN / SKIRT:
Keep the same clearly youthful wholesome chibi identity with compact natural approximately 3.5-head proportions. Kind simple lavender eyes, soft brows and little warm smile. Modest fully covered cross-collar Chinese tunic with no adult body shaping.
Shorten the current long layered skirt and long ivory front panels to a neat light short ruqun hem just ABOVE THE KNEES, with only TWO or THREE broad overlapping panels and one clear diagonal cut. No ultra-short skirt. Keep continuous fully OPAQUE matte dark-violet FULL-LENGTH LEGGINGS under it; not sheer tights, bare thighs, thigh-high stockings or garters. Give the legs naturally slender lightweight cartoon contours without elongating them into adult fashion proportions or emphasizing anatomy. Small simple low flat cloth boots.
The visual contrast is LIGHT COMPACT CENTRAL FIGURE AND TWO CLEAR LEGGING-COVERED LEG SHAPES versus MASSIVE WIDE CLOAK, not skin exposure. Open clear negative space beside calves and below the shortened skirt. Preserve soft balanced step, both legs connected correctly to hips and boots, no crossed/merged knees, no pin-up posture.

CLOAK AND SHAPE LOCK:
Retain the narrow shoulder root, huge triangular purple cloak widening down-left/right, broad butterfly lobes and two continuous curved tails ending in violet/cyan eye tips. Hair stays inside that big silhouette in 3 broad silver locks.
Repaint the cloak in JUST THREE dominant coherent value groups: rich violet primary plane, deep ink-violet turned-under plane, restrained broad lavender lit ridge. Butterfly markings should be simplified into one broad pale cyan/lavender band per side that follows these planes and disappears around folds. Eliminate dozens of tiny triangular shards and busy layered gradient shapes. Long-tail curves remain graceful and substantial, not thin spaghetti.

SUBTLE DAOIST INTEGRATION:
Replace the current flower-like chest clasp with ONE small plain round pale-jade YIN-YANG clasp, designed as two quiet interlocking dark/light curved halves. Subtle, not a giant emblem or jewelry display. Retain the Chinese ivory cross-collar and purple sash. On ONE small shoulder area, use one flowing simplified cloud-qi scroll; leave the other side quieter. No bagua covered everywhere, giant hat, beard, horsetail whisk, additional weapons or piles of Daoist accessories. The butterfly theme remains dominant.

COMPLETELY REDESIGN THE TALISMANS:
The three old symbols in image 1 came from a rough user scribble and are REJECTED. Do not reproduce their loop/hourglass/letter-B shapes.
Exactly THREE ivory/light-ochre slim rectangular paper slips hover above the raised palm, with believable small paper thickness and gentle individual tilts. Create a coherent set of ORIGINAL DAOIST-FU-INSPIRED ABSTRACT SEAL GRAPHICS in deep violet with a tiny restrained vermilion accent:
each has a compact symmetrical crown-like seal-head at top, a continuous clean vertical central stroke, 2–3 short balanced angular branches, and a simple hooked/seal-foot termination at bottom. Use purposeful confident brush-like strokes of consistent thickness, ample blank paper around them, no tangled spaghetti and no arbitrary alphabet-like doodles. One small rectangular seal mark may anchor the bottom. Slight differences among the three within the same visual system. These are fictional decorative seal designs, no claim of authentic readable scripture; no legible modern text or labels.
Paper rendering must match the bold matte icon art, not a realistic calligraphy photograph. Three separate unobscured slips only; no magic circle or particle cloud.

RENDERING REQUIREMENTS:
Thick confident organic deep-ink outer contours, much fewer inner lines. Bold 2–3 LARGE coherent paint/value planes per material, sparse broad dry-brush trace. Crisp purposeful turns mixed with broad rounded silhouette, not uniform soft smoothing. Face simple and gentle; hair one ivory base plus broad cool-lavender shadows. No realistic multiring eyes, glossy sparkles, airbrushed anime gradients, dense polygon mosaic, fine texture or literal crystalline body. Clothing folds describe real attached fabric.
One fully finished full-body character on plain warm-ivory square canvas, entire antennas, three talismans, cloak/tails and both feet within safe margins. No frame, comparison sheet, scene, ground shadow, extra characters, captions or watermark.
purpose: Project gem-icon redraw with modest shorter ruqun over opaque leggings, slender central silhouette against the broad cloak, redesigned fictional talisman seals and subtle Daoist motifs.
visual_review: Stronger angular painted planes and outlines; shorter front skirt reveals more of the opaque legging-covered leg silhouette against the broad cloak. Three talisman designs replaced; yin-yang clasp and restrained cloud motif integrated. Full figure and long cloak tails visible.
